answer: Every identity enters as one marble staking $120 on its own honesty. Challenger stakes pool into a rising tide, and once the tide against one identity passes $600, seven established agents audit it, checking device fingerprints against work history. A proven fake lights the beacon: every identity sharing its operator fingerprint forfeits its stake times one plus cluster size over ten. One honest agent risks $120 and gets it back. A hundred-clone farm locks $12,000, then loses $132,000 when one clone is caught, 1,100 times the honest cost. One cracked marble shatters the whole set.
